about: Camera spots for the walkable outer road, part 1 (S4, u 9400-12600), in the one world frame shared with the gate (metres: X east = away from the city, D north, H height; facing_deg 0 = +X east, 90 = north). Everything placed in the world comes from the scroll map through layout.json (tools/map_layout.mjs); this file only says where the camera can stand.

seam.about: just east of the moat bridge (the S5 seam), looking up the outer road (the spawn)

stalls.about: the bridgehead stalls: the mat awnings, the dark and the light parasols, the heaped basket and its crowd

carts.about: the second covered ox cart and its oxen, the rider with the fan coming the other way

sedans.about: the two sedan chairs carried west on the far side of the road

side_road.about: up the side open ground: the pigs, the pack donkeys at the thatched stall, the shop and the temple at the top

temple.about: the temple's gate hall with its shut studded door, its side door where the monk goes in

post.about: the courier post: the gate with its notice, the idle soldiers on the forecourt, the spears, the planked ditch and the little bridge

yard.about: inside the courier post's gate: the yard, the white horse lying, the saddle on its stand

fortune.about: the fortune-teller under his mat awning with the signs 決□ 看命 神課

eating_house.about: the eating house's open front from the south, its tables and benches

east_end.about: the east end at the inner seam: the big willow, the official hall, the parasol
